# Large regression fixtures

Large real-world trajectory fixtures belong here and are tracked with Git LFS.

The Lenina fixture used by CI is:

- `lenina_video_sample_20mb.json`

The regression is based on the manually annotated three-state structure:

`EW -> N_ARROW -> NS`

with median cycle characteristics of approximately 99 s / 49 s / 22 s / 30 s.

Do not put generated analysis outputs in this directory.
